note.value:
Range: 2d6"
Effect: Roll 3d6, check for doubles:
Double 1: Firethrower explodes discard firethrower then do 1 damage to a random low location (reroll misses)
Double 2-5: Do one wound, no save
Double 6: Target is destroyed
